entries.reason: The exact v3.8.1 frontend contract has not been mapped to typed Tauri dialogs.
Clipboard semantics have not been exercised in an embedded SiYuan surface.
An allowlisted external-link bridge has not been implemented.
Browser-served import and export limitations have no Tauri replacement.
Print and PDF behavior has not been mapped or verified.
Required window-level desktop contracts have not been inventoried.
No least-privilege shell action registry exists for the SiYuan surface.
Plugin install, enable, disable, and permission behavior has not been bridged.
